literal: From doubt having departed to those who are clear, than the earth heaven nearness possesses.
translation: To those who have freed themselves from doubt and attained clarity, heaven is nearer than the earth.
modern: ஐயங்களிலிருந்து விடுபட்டு தெளிந்த அறிவைப் பெற்றவர்களுக்கு, இந்த உலகத்தை விட வானுலகம் மிகவும் நெருக்கமானதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of clear, doubt-free understanding. The phrase 'ஐயத்தின் நீங்கி' means departing from all uncertainties and illusions. For those who achieve such flawless clarity ('தெளிந்தார்க்கு'), the ultimate state of heaven ('வானம்') becomes closer and more accessible than the physical earth ('வையத்தின்') they stand on. The word 'நணியது' denotes nearness, showing that spiritual liberation is immediately within reach for the truly realized.
